sentences.l2: 自己动手做堆肥很简单。
sentences.l1: Making compost yourself is very simple.
You can use kitchen waste to make fertilizer.

sentences.l2: 吃剩的菜、水果皮、茶叶渣都可以用。
sentences.l1: Leftover food, fruit peels and tea leaves can all be used.

sentences.l2: 在箱子的底部和侧面扎一些小孔。
sentences.l1: Poke some small holes in the bottom and sides of the box.
Put the kitchen waste into the box.
Then add some soil and fallen leaves.
Do not put in meat or bones.

sentences.l2: 过几周，厨余会变成黑黑的土。
sentences.l1: After a few weeks, the kitchen waste will turn into dark soil.
It can be used to grow flowers and vegetables.
It can also help plants grow.

sentences.l2: 这是很好的可持续生活方法。
sentences.l1: This is a very good way of sustainable living.
